title: Bind workspace preferences to the verified member
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · The client host derives the preference identity from the active v0.1 session. Keep existing saved settings readable and preserve independent updates when two client windows or hosts save concurrently.

**Related earlier work** · WI-036

**Delivery dependencies** · Can begin on the current PR head. Coordinate the shared session boundary with the companion fix.

**Verify** · Verify distinct member settings, host-side rejection of invalid or expired sessions, preserved concurrent writes and failed-write recovery. Restart on a different port and verify both settings sets. Keep the existing v0.1 contract.

**Delivery** · v0.2 client, existing PR #9.
